entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive in St Kitts and Nevis.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada a San Cristóbal y Nieves.
entry.quote: To enter St Kitts and Nevis, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: Visitors can stay in St Kitts and Nevis for up to 6 months without a visa.
entry.es: Los visitantes pueden permanecer en San Cristóbal y Nieves hasta 6 meses sin visado.
entry.quote: You can visit St Kitts and Nevis without a visa for up to 6 months.

entry.en: All visitors must obtain an Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA) before travel.
entry.es: Todos los visitantes deben obtener una Autorización Electrónica de Viaje (eTA) antes de viajar.
entry.quote: All visitors to St Kitts and Nevis must obtain an Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA) before travel.

entry.en: You should complete the immigration form online before travelling to speed up arrival.
entry.es: Debe completar el formulario de inmigración en línea antes de viajar para agilizar la llegada.
entry.quote: Before you travel, complete the immigration form online to speed up your arrival in St Kitts and Nevis.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si viene de un país con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Arrival and departure tax is usually included in the ticket price of most commercial flights.
entry.es: La tasa de llegada y salida suele estar incluida en el precio del billete de la mayoría de los vuelos comerciales.
entry.quote: Arrival and departure tax is usually included in the ticket price of most commercial flights.

safety.en: There have been incidents of serious crime including murder, armed robbery and sexual assault.
safety.es: Ha habido incidentes de delitos graves, incluidos asesinato, robo a mano armada y agresión sexual.
safety.quote: There have been incidents of serious crime including murder, armed robbery and sexual assault.

safety.en: Avoid isolated areas, including beaches, after dark.
safety.es: Evite las zonas aisladas, incluidas las playas, después del anochecer.
safety.quote: avoid isolated areas, including beaches, after dark

safety.en: It is illegal for anyone, including children, to dress in camouflage clothing.
safety.es: Es ilegal que cualquier persona, incluidos los niños, vista ropa de camuflaje.
safety.quote: It is illegal for anyone, including children, to dress in camouflage clothing.

safety.en: Hurricane season runs from June to November.
safety.es: La temporada de huracanes va de junio a noviembre.
safety.quote: The hurricane season runs from June to November.

safety.en: Mount Liamuiga is a potentially active volcano and is likely to erupt in the future.
safety.es: El monte Liamuiga es un volcán potencialmente activo y es probable que erupcione en el futuro.
safety.quote: Mount Liamuiga is a potentially active volcano and is likely to erupt in the future.

safety.en: Attitudes towards the LGBT+ community are mostly conservative in the Caribbean, and public affection may receive unwanted attention.
safety.es: Las actitudes hacia la comunidad LGBT+ son mayormente conservadoras en el Caribe, y las muestras públicas de afecto pueden recibir atención no deseada.
safety.quote: Attitudes towards the LGBT+ community are mostly conservative in the Caribbean.

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink.
health.es: El agua del grifo es segura para beber.
health.quote: Tap water is safe to drink.

health.en: Medical treatment in St Kitts and Nevis is expensive.
health.es: El tratamiento médico en San Cristóbal y Nieves es caro.
health.quote: Medical treatment in St Kitts and Nevis is expensive.

health.en: The main government hospital in St Kitts is the Joseph N France General Hospital in Brumaire.
health.es: El principal hospital público de San Cristóbal es el Joseph N France General Hospital en Brumaire.
health.quote: The main government hospital in St Kitts is the Joseph N France General Hospital in Brumaire.

health.en: Serious cases may require emergency evacuation.
health.es: Los casos graves pueden requerir evacuación de emergencia.
health.quote: However, serious cases may require emergency evacuation.

health.en: Travellers should have adequate medical travel insurance or accessible funds to cover treatment and repatriation.
health.es: Los viajeros deben tener un seguro médico de viaje adecuado o fondos accesibles para cubrir tratamiento y repatriación.
health.quote: Make sure you have adequate medical travel insurance and or accessible funds to cover the cost of medical treatment and repatriation.

help.quote: Call 911 and ask for an ambulance.

help.en: Emergency numbers are 911 for ambulance and police and 333 for fire.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son 911 para ambulancia y policía y 333 para bomberos.

help.en: The coastguard can be reached on 465 8484 or 466 9280.
help.es: La guardia costera puede contactarse en el 465 8484 o 466 9280.

getting_in.en: Robert L Bradshaw International Airport on St. Kitts is the main hub of the islands.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional Robert L Bradshaw en San Cristóbal es el principal centro de las islas.
getting_in.quote: Robert L Bradshaw International (SKB IATA) on St. Kitts is the main hub of the islands.

getting_in.en: Vance W. Amory International Airport on Nevis is a smaller airport with connections from several Caribbean hubs.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional Vance W. Amory en Nieves es más pequeño y tiene conexiones desde varios centros del Caribe.
getting_in.quote: Vance W. Amory International Airport (NEV IATA) on Nevis is a smaller airport, and has connections from a number of Caribbean hubs.

getting_in.en: Makana Ferry offers crossings to Sint Maarten, Sint Eustatius and Saba on Mondays, Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays.
getting_in.es: Makana Ferry ofrece travesías a Sint Maarten, Sint Eustatius y Saba los lunes, viernes, sábados y domingos.
getting_in.quote: Makana Ferry offers crossings to Sint Maarten, Sint Eustatius, and Saba on Mondays, Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays.

getting_in.en: British Airways has a once-weekly non-stop flight from London Gatwick on Saturdays.
getting_in.es: British Airways tiene un vuelo directo semanal desde Londres Gatwick los sábados.
getting_in.quote: From Britain, British Airways has non-stop flights from London Gatwick. These flights are once a week, on Saturdays.

getting_in.en: There is a cruise ship terminal as well as a marina for yachts in Basseterre.
getting_in.es: Hay una terminal de cruceros y una marina para yates en Basseterre.
getting_in.quote: There is a cruise ship terminal as well as a marina for yachts in Basseterre.

getting_around.en: Passenger ferries run every day between Charlestown on Nevis and Port Zante in Basseterre, with a fare of US$12.5 per adult as of 2025.
getting_around.es: Los ferris de pasajeros operan a diario entre Charlestown en Nieves y Port Zante en Basseterre, con tarifa de 12,5 dólares por adulto en 2025.
getting_around.quote: Several passenger ferries run every day between Charlestown, the capital of Nevis, and Port Zante in Basseterre, which is the capital of St. Kitts.

getting_around.en: Taxis are not metered, so you should agree the fare with the driver before you set off.
getting_around.es: Los taxis no tienen taxímetro, por lo que debe acordar la tarifa con el conductor antes de partir.
getting_around.quote: Taxis are not metered. There are standard taxi fares for most destinations. Agree the fare with the driver before you set off.

getting_around.en: Taxis charge 50% extra from 10PM to 6AM, and drivers expect a 10% tip.
getting_around.es: Los taxis cobran un 50% extra de 22:00 a 6:00, y los conductores esperan una propina del 10%.
getting_around.quote: Taxis charge 50% extra from 10PM to 6AM, and drivers expect a 10% tip.

getting_around.en: Micro buses form the public transport system and are much cheaper than taxis.
getting_around.es: Los microbuses forman el sistema de transporte público y son mucho más baratos que los taxis.
getting_around.quote: Micro buses form the public transportation system on the island. These are much cheaper than taxis and can be flagged down while in route.

getting_around.en: Bus fare is EC$3.50 for a trip of 5 miles or under (2025), and buses do not operate after 7-8PM.
getting_around.es: La tarifa de autobús es de 3,50 EC$ para trayectos de 5 millas o menos (2025), y los autobuses no operan después de las 19-20 h.
getting_around.quote: Bus fare is EC$3.50 for a trip of 5 miles or under (2025), and up to 50% more for longer rides. Buses do not operate after 7-8PM.

getting_around.en: Driving in St Kitts and Nevis requires a local driving licence, and a temporary one can be bought from the Inland Revenue Department.
getting_around.es: Para conducir en San Cristóbal y Nieves se necesita licencia local, y se puede comprar una temporal en el Departamento de Rentas Internas.
getting_around.quote: You must have a St Kitts and Nevis driving licence. You can buy a temporary licence from the Inland Revenue Department

money.en: The currency is the East Caribbean dollar (XCD), pegged to the US dollar at US$1 = EC$2.70.
money.es: La moneda es el dólar del Caribe Oriental (XCD), fijado al dólar estadounidense a US$1 = EC$2,70.
money.quote: The currency of the country is the East Caribbean dollar, denoted by the symbol: "$" or "EC$" (ISO currency code: XCD)

money.en: US dollar cash is widely accepted, usually at an exchange rate of 2.5.
money.es: El efectivo en dólares estadounidenses es ampliamente aceptado, normalmente a un tipo de 2,5.
money.quote: The US dollar cash is widely accepted, usually at an exchange rate of 2.5 which gives a slight advantage to the retailer.

money.en: Credit cards are widely accepted, and you can pay in EC or US dollars at the official exchange rate.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito son ampliamente aceptadas y se puede pagar en dólares del Caribe Oriental o estadounidenses al tipo oficial.
money.quote: Credit cards are widely accepted, and you can pay in EC or US dollars at the official exchange rate.

money.en: Prices in St Kitts and Nevis are pretty reasonable, though fuel is expensive as it has to be imported.
money.es: Los precios en San Cristóbal y Nieves son bastante razonables, aunque el combustible es caro por ser importado.
money.quote: prices on St Kitts & Nevis are pretty reasonable. Fuel is expensive as it has to be imported

etiquette.en: Wear shoes and a shirt in the city and public places, as beach attire in the city is a sign of disrespect.
etiquette.es: Use zapatos y camisa en la ciudad y lugares públicos, pues la ropa de playa en la ciudad es una falta de respeto.
etiquette.quote: It is important when in the city and other public places (airport, downtown, stores) to wear shoes and a shirt.  It is a sign of disrespect to be wearing beach attire in the city.

etiquette.en: Loud public swearing is looked down upon and you can be fined for it.
etiquette.es: Las groserías en voz alta en público están mal vistas y se puede recibir una multa.
etiquette.quote: Loud public swearing is also looked down upon and you can be fined for it.

connectivity.en: Mobile coverage is good in most areas, and you can get a local SIM card or use international roaming.
connectivity.es: La cobertura móvil es buena en la mayoría de las zonas, y se puede obtener una SIM local o usar roaming internacional.
connectivity.quote: Mobile coverage is good in most areas, and you can get a local SIM card or use your phone with international roaming.

connectivity.en: Most hotels, restaurants and cafes offer free Wi-Fi.
connectivity.es: La mayoría de hoteles, restaurantes y cafés ofrecen Wi-Fi gratuito.
connectivity.quote: Most hotels, restaurants and cafes offer free Wi-Fi.

connectivity.en: WhatsApp is popular in Saint Kitts and Nevis.
connectivity.es: WhatsApp es popular en San Cristóbal y Nieves.
connectivity.quote: WhatsApp is popular in Saint Kitts and Nevis.
